name: run_command
title: Run console command
description: Send a raw console command to a running, bridge-patched Zandronum instance and return its captured output.

name: list_actor_classes
title: List actor classes
description: Run `dumpactors` and return the registered DECORATE/actor classes as structured data.

engineState.description: The engine-state note, present only on a reply that prints one.

name: summon
title: Summon actor
description: Spawn an actor of the given class at the player's position (use summon_at for exact map coordinates).

name: summon_at
title: Summon actor at coordinates
description: Run `mcp_spawnat`: spawn an actor at exact map x/y (each coordinate within -32768..32767; z defaults to the floor, angle in degrees, 0 east) and report it in the same call, even while paused (it thinks once the sim runs). The reply's class is the actual spawned class after any mod replacement (requested= shows the asked-for name when it differs); use it and the returned tid for follow-ups with find_actors/actor_state. tid defaults to a fresh unique TID; tid 0 means none. kind friend/foe matches summonfriend/summonfoe. The spawn is refused, reporting why, for an unknown class or a spot blocked by an actor, a line or the floor/ceiling fit; force skips that check. A point in the void is only caught by the floor/ceiling check here. health, special + args (up to 5, zero-padded), ambush and dormant are set at spawn time. Missile classes spawn inert.

name: set_cheat
title: Set a cheat on or off
description: Idempotently turn a player cheat on or off. Reads the cheat bit from the engine-state snapshot and only runs the stock toggle CCMD (god, notarget, ...) when it differs, then waits for the bit to flip, so a blind toggle can never switch it the wrong way. Uses the engine's normal net path. Needs a bridge with the status cap and a cheats= field.

name: give
title: Give item
description: Give an inventory item to the player.

name: take
title: Take item
description: Remove an inventory item from the player.

name: load_map
title: Load map
description: Load a map by its lump name (e.g. MAP01, E1M1). Cheats such as god and notarget reset with the map: set them again with set_cheat.

name: list_running_scripts
title: List running ACS scripts
description: Run `scriptstat` and return the currently running ACS scripts and their states.

engineState.description: The engine-state note, present only on a reply that prints one.

name: run_script
title: Run ACS script
description: Run (puke) an ACS script by number or name, with optional integer arguments.

name: run_acs
title: Hot-load and run an ACS snippet
description: Compile full ACS source host-side (bcc by default: zt-bcc or bcc on PATH, with zt-bcc's lib/ found next to or one folder above the binary; or acc on PATH; ZANDRONUM_BCC/ZANDRONUM_ACC override the executables) and load it into the running level as a temporary module, then optionally run one of its scripts by number or name with up to 4 args. The script runs inside this call until its first delay, so its Log() output comes back in the reply (Print() is a HUD message: use read_hud); stepTics then runs the sim that many tics and returns the log lines printed meanwhile. A snippet that isn't a #library is compiled as one, so its strings resolve. It may #import a library the level already loaded (pass includeDirs for its source) and then shares that library's live functions and map vars; importing a library that isn't loaded is refused before anything is sent. open runs its OPEN scripts. Compile errors come back without touching the engine. Offline only (no server/client). Zandronum can't unload a module: one the engine rejects stays loaded, inert, and every snippet stays until the map changes. While any is loaded save_game refuses: a save would fail to load (in-game saves and leaving a hub level carry the same hazard, which this tool can't intercept).

includeDirs.description: Absolute paths; a relative one resolves against the MCP server's working directory.

name: screenshot
title: Screenshot
description: Take a screenshot of the game and return it as an image so it can be viewed.

name: screenshot_file
title: Screenshot to a file
description: Take a screenshot and leave it on disk, returning only its absolute path (no image content). For measuring pixels with a script instead of viewing the frame. A reused `name` overwrites that file.

name: menu_key
title: Press a menu key
description: Send a single menu navigation key (GUI key event) to the active menu.

name: menu_nav
title: Navigate a menu
description: Send a sequence of menu keys (e.g. ["down","down","enter"]) with a small delay between each.

name: menu_text
title: Type into a menu text field
description: Type a string into the active menu text-entry field (e.g. the player name box after pressing enter on it), one character at a time.

name: mouse_move
title: Move the mouse pointer
description: Move the pointer to a screen position, in pixels from the top-left of the game window. Drives hover-only UI -- tooltips, hot states -- which nothing else here can reach.

name: mouse_click
title: Click or drag the mouse
description: Press and release the left button at a position. Give toX/toY to DRAG: press at the first point, move through it, release at the second. `double` sends a double-click.

name: mouse_wheel
title: Scroll the mouse wheel
description: Wheel notches at the current pointer position. Positive scrolls up, negative down.

name: verify_menu
title: Open, navigate, and screenshot a menu
description: Open a menu (via a console command like `menu_options`), apply navigation steps, then return a screenshot to verify it.

name: set_pause
title: Pause or resume the game
description: Set the engine's master pause flag directly. Use this to resume a backgrounded instance that auto-paused on focus loss, so the simulation keeps advancing while the MCP drives it.

name: step
title: Advance the game by N tics
description: Resume the game, let it run for the given number of tics (35 tics = 1 second), then pause again. Lets you advance the simulation a deterministic-ish amount to observe time-based effects (charging, projectiles, animations) without keeping the window focused.

name: ensure_live
title: Check that the sim is advancing
description: Prove the simulation actually advances: list what could block it (menu, console, chat, automap, not in a level, dead/spectating player, demo, a pending map/save/demo load), then run it ~5 tics and check the map tic counter moved. A pending load is waited out first (up to ~5 s). The pause state is left as found, since `paused` is the normal driving state and `step` runs through it. With fix, first closes the menu (`closemenu`) and hides the console, chat and automap (`mcp_unblock`). Returns live plus the blockers found, fixed and remaining.

name: step_until
title: Step until a condition holds
description: Advance the sim in chunks of chunkTics until a condition holds or maxTics run out, then leave it paused like `step`. The condition compares a map var, map array element, ACS world/global var or player field (x, y, z, angle, floorHeight, sector, light, health, armor) against a number, or a player field against another field (e.g. z == floorHeight). Reports the map tics that actually elapsed. Fails fast with the blocker list if a chunk doesn't advance the map tic counter.

name: get_acs_var
title: Get ACS variable
description: Read an ACS world or global variable by index.

name: set_acs_var
title: Set ACS variable
description: Write an ACS world or global variable by index.

name: list_acs_vars
title: List non-zero ACS variables
description: Run `dumpacsvars` and return all non-zero ACS world/global variables, optionally filtered by scope.

name: acs_index
title: Index ACS source
description: Parse a directory of .acs source files and return symbol counts (scripts, functions, numeric defines). Reads files directly; no game needed.

name: find_acs_symbol
title: Find ACS symbol
description: Resolve a script number or a script/function name to its symbol(s) — name, number, file:line. Turns a profiler 'script 1017' into a source location.

name: behavior_names
title: Read ACS names from compiled bytecode
description: Read function and named-script names from a mod's compiled ACS (BEHAVIOR/library lumps) in a WAD or PK3 — for source-less mods. Numbered scripts have no names in bytecode (use find_acs_symbol with source for those).

name: list_map_exports
title: List exported map variables from compiled bytecode
description: List each ACS module's exported map variables and arrays (MEXP/ARAY chunks) from a WAD, PK3 or compiled .o, with slot index and array size. get_map_var/get_map_array only see exported names, so check here before a launch or pk3 rebuild. `lump` narrows to modules whose name or basename matches (e.g. `mymod` for `acs/mymod.o`).

name: list_saves
title: List savegames
description: List .zds savegames in the save directory with metadata (title, map, engine, game wad, creation time) read from each save's PNG text chunks. No running game needed.

name: save_game
title: Save the game
description: Run `save` to write a savegame (single-player / cooperative only). NOTE: saving heavily-scripted mods can crash the engine — All-out-War crashes on save; vanilla and simple maps save fine.

name: load_game
title: Load a savegame
description: Run `load` to restore a savegame by name.

name: play_demo
title: Play a demo
description: Run `playdemo` to play back a recorded .lmp demo. (Recording is via the -record launch arg, not a console command.)

name: player_state
title: Player state
description: Run `currentpos` and return the player's position, angle, floor height, sector, light level, and (on a status-capable bridge) health, armor, and whether the player is alive, dead, or spectating.

name: actor_state
title: Actor state (DECORATE)
description: Run `dumpactor` and return an actor's live state: class, health, position, angle, pitch, current DECORATE state (sprite/frame/tics, e.g. TNT1 A 0), inventory, and (for players) ready weapon + morph status. Defaults to the player; pass a TID for any actor, plus index for the nth actor sharing it.

index.description: Pick the nth (0-based) actor sharing the TID; needs tid.

name: read_hud
title: Read on-screen HUD
description: Run `dumphud` and return everything the engine painted last frame: HUD text strings (with screen x/y), images (by texture name + position), and active ACS HUD messages (full composed text, layer, position, remaining tics). Captures menus too.

name: actors_near
title: Actors near the player
description: Run `actorsnear` and return actors within a radius (map units, default 512) of the player: class, health, position, and current sprite.

name: inspect_target
title: Inspect aimed target
description: Run `linetarget` and return the actor the player is aiming at (class, health, spawn health).

name: set_view
title: Set the player's view
description: Point the player's view: an absolute angle (degrees, Doom convention: 0 east, 90 north) with optional pitch (degrees, negative looks up), or face an actor by tid (first actor with it) or class (nearest map actor of that class, aiming at its mid-height). Give exactly one of angle, tid, class.

name: list_players
title: List players
description: Run `dumpplayers` and return every in-game player: slot, bot, spectator/dead-spectator, player state, health, armor, ready weapon, x/y/z, angle, pitch, TID, cheat bits, frags, deaths, kills/items/secrets, points, wins, team, ping and name. Bots join at slot 1+.

name: find_actors
title: Find actors map-wide
description: Run `findactors` and list map actors (owned inventory excluded), optionally filtered by class (includes subclasses), TID and radius around the player, sorted by distance. Each has class, tid, hp/spawnhp, x/y/z, angle, pitch, dist, sprite/frame, flags (monster, friendly, corpse, dormant, shootable, solid, invulnerable, ambush) and target. detail adds master/tracer, special + args, vel, radius/height, floorz and player index. With a tid filter each result also has index, the one to pass to actor_state(tid, index) for it (the list is in distance order, not index order).

name: list_scripts
title: List ACS scripts
description: Run `dumpscripts` and return every script across loaded modules (module, number, name, type, arg count).

name: list_functions
title: List ACS functions
description: Run `dumpfunctions` and return named ACS functions across loaded modules.

name: profile_scripts
title: Profile ACS scripts
description: Run `acsprofile` and return per-script/function execution stats (total instructions, runs, avg/min/max).

name: profile_window
title: Profile a time window
description: Clear ACS profiling, wait N seconds, then return what ran during that window — `what's hot right now` rather than cumulative since map start.

name: list_modules
title: List loaded ACS modules
description: Run `dumpmodules` and return the loaded ACS modules (id + name). Map vars live only while a map is loaded.

name: get_map_var
title: Get map variable
description: Read a map-scope ACS variable by name (searched across loaded modules).

name: set_map_var
title: Set map variable
description: Write a map-scope ACS variable by name.

name: get_map_array
title: Get map array element
description: Read one element of a map-scope ACS array by name and index.

name: set_map_array
title: Set map array element
description: Write one element of a map-scope ACS array by name and index.

name: renderer_info
title: Renderer info
description: Active backend (software/opengl), GL vendor/shader model, resolution, fullscreen/vsync.

name: viewport_info
title: Viewport info
description: The 3D view window rect (x/y/width/height) and screenblocks size.

name: hud_info
title: HUD info
description: Status bar Y position, status bar / HUD scale, alt HUD, crosshair.

name: map_info
title: Map info
description: Read a map from a WAD and return its format (doom/hexen/udmf) and entity counts. Reads the file directly — the game need not be running.

name: get_sector
title: Get sector
description: Return one sector's properties by index (all fields, format-native keys).

name: get_linedef
title: Get linedef
description: Return one linedef by index, with its referenced sidedefs (textures + offsets) resolved.

name: find_sectors_by_tag
title: Find sectors by tag
description: Return all sectors whose tag/id matches (binary `tag` or UDMF `id`).

name: launch_instance
title: Launch a Zandronum instance
description: Spawn a bridge-enabled Zandronum process with the given options and attach to it. Requires ZANDRONUM_EXE to be set.

iwad.description: Path to the IWAD. Defaults to ZANDRONUM_IWAD if set, otherwise the engine's own IWAD search.

name: attach_instance
title: Attach to an engine you started yourself
description: Connect to a bridge-patched Zandronum that is ALREADY running — one you launched by hand, or from a terminal — and bind it to an instance number for the other tools. Only needed for engines this session didn't launch: launch_instance binds automatically. Defaults to this instance's conventional port. Refuses an instance whose launched engine is still running.

name: kill_instance
title: Kill a Zandronum instance
description: Stop a launched instance and detach from it. Asks the engine to quit itself first (a hard kill mid-render can wedge macOS GPU teardown and leave an unkillable process), then force-kills if it doesn't exit.

name: reset
title: Reset — reap this session's engine instances
description: Kill every instance this session launched, and reap engines ORPHANED by earlier sessions (whose launcher is gone) that could otherwise squat bridge ports. Engines belonging to another running editor window are left alone. Pass all:true to also kill those — only do that if you know no other session is using this engine build.

all.description: Also kill engines owned by other live MCP sessions using this same build.

name: get_startup_errors
title: Get engine startup errors
description: Read the engine's captured console log for an instance and surface DECORATE/ACS compile errors and fatal startup errors. Works even when the bridge never came up (e.g. the engine aborted on a bad script) — exactly when the other tools can't connect.

name: read_log
title: Read the engine console log
description: Read an instance's engine console log, which catches prints that never come back in a command reply (e.g. cheat ON/OFF messages, emitted a tic later). Correlation sentinel lines are dropped. `pattern` is a case-insensitive regex filter. Without `sinceLine` this returns the last `maxLines` matches; with it, the first `maxLines` matches after that line. Pass the returned `nextLine` as `sinceLine` to read only what was logged since.

name: get_crash
title: Get the last engine crash backtrace
description: Return the signal, faulting address, and symbolized backtrace the bridge's crash handler captured the last time the engine crashed (segfault/abort/bus error/etc.). Use this when an instance dies unexpectedly — e.g. run_command reports the bridge closed. A report left by another engine (different PID) is named but not returned as this instance's crash; one that can't be tied to this engine (its PID is unknown, or the report has no pid line) is returned marked `Unverified:`.
